labor.task: Shop: cut, fit & weld 3 pin-pile/post assemblies; vent holes
Shop: load/unload galvanizer, black finish on posts
Field: auger 21 post holes 12" dia, rock base
Field: drive 3 Pipe 4 STD pin piles at trees
Field: set/plumb posts on piles, touch-up
Office: submittals (MTRs, data sheets, color chart, shop dwg)

other.item: Hydraulic breaker w/ pile-driving adapter rental

scope.title: Perimeter chain-link fence (Tag MF, 3/L6.3)
scope.text: Furnish and install 230 LF of 4'-0" high chain-link fence, PVC-coated black, in two straight runs (150' and 80') with 1 corner, 2 end and 1 pull post. 2" mesh 9 ga core / 8 ga finished fabric (ASTM F668 Class 2b), knuckled top and bottom; 1-7/8" OD line posts at 10'-0" max; 2-3/8" OD Sch 40 terminal posts; 1-5/8" OD top rail; 7 ga bottom tension wire with hog rings at 18" o.c.; ties at 12" o.c.; Class C concrete footings 12" dia x 24"/30" on 4" compacted crushed-rock base.

scope.title: Fence supports at existing trees (Pipe 4 STD pin piles, S-series detail)
scope.text: Fabricate and install 3 fence support assemblies at existing trees: Pipe 4 STD (A53 Gr B) pin pile 6'-2" long, 1/2" x 6-1/2" x 6-1/2" A36 cap plate, 1-1/2" Sch 40 post 4'-2" above pile; hot-dip galvanized after fabrication (ASTM A123) and finished black to match fence.

scope.title: Submittals and compliance
scope.text: Mill test reports, manufacturer data sheets, PVC color chart, shop drawing of pin-pile support, L&I Intents/Affidavits and certified payroll.

exclusions: Additive Bid #1 in full (Gateway, Metal Museum Rail at decking, Site Benches, Pebble Seats, Concrete Plank System).
Concrete curbs, paving, flatwork, play equipment and surfacing (OFOI), site furnishings (trash/recycling receptacle), lighting.
Removal/disposal of existing fencing, tree protection fencing, survey/layout control, permits and permit fees.
Rock, roots or obstructions encountered during post-hole excavation; spoils hauled off site (spoils left in place by others).
Performance & payment bond (add 1.5% if required), Washington retail sales tax (collected by prime per WAC 458-20-171).
